description.p: Stickies puts small, colourful notes anywhere on your screen and puts them back where you left them the next time you log in — on the right monitor, at the right size.

ul.li: One window per note, in seven colours
Positions remembered per monitor, so unplugging a display does not scatter your notes
Notes can be kept on top of other windows

description.p: Restoring positions requires the companion “Stickies Window Placement” GNOME Shell extension. Wayland does not let an application position its own windows, so the extension does it from inside the compositor. Without it, Stickies still keeps your notes, colours and sizes — only placement is left to the window manager.
